tasks.title: P6-01 / Phase 0 spike + go/no-go + size/perf baseline (S) — throwaway `spikes/lwc/` proving the 9 API behaviours, results doc with gate record
tasks.description: Build ONLY the throwaway Phase 0 spike in `spikes/lwc/` proving the 9 API behaviours from the attached migration plan, record the measured `.app` size delta and the signing-flow finding plus the Phase-0 perf baseline in `docs/lwc_spike_results.md` with an explicit go/no-go record, and create the 19-row `docs/lwc_parity_matrix.md` skeleton (all rows Open). Nothing in `spikes/lwc/` may be imported by production or tests, it ships no test of its own into the suite book, and it is excluded from packaging. A recorded no-go stops Phase 1 (P6-T02 must not proceed on a no-go).

AC2 — Given the spike is throwaway (AP-P6-2, A105), When the task is done, Then no production module and no test module imports anything under `spikes/` (a repo-wide import scan is clean) and the spike ships no test file into `tests/`.

AC3 — Given Q61 is measure-first (A109, DG89), When the task is done, Then `docs/lwc_spike_results.md` records the measured `.app` size delta, the signing-flow finding (whether the current flow covers the Chromium/vendored tree), and the Phase-0 perf baseline the P6-12 cutover gate holds.

AC4 — Given the parity matrix is the gate (AC-D47.9, S58), When the task is done, Then `docs/lwc_parity_matrix.md` exists with all 19 rows listed and every row dispositioned Open/pending, and a later row regressing without an escalation fails review (rule 10).
